method: Built-in image_gen; six separate transparent edits of project reference sprites. Original generated PNGs preserved; export_potion_tiers.ps1 performs deterministic 128x128 format export only.
author_request: Medium silver details; large both silver and gold, including medikits.

prompt_set.common: Edit the existing reference sprite. Preserve the family color, silhouette, perspective, transparent background and detailed dark-fantasy game-art style. Single complete centered object, no labels/text/background, legible at 128x128.
prompt_set.medikit_medium: Brown leather medikit, red square white medical cross, bandage left. All metal fittings, buckles, studs, protective corners and narrow reinforcing trim visibly cool silver; no gold or brass.
prompt_set.medikit_large: Same medikit; broad silver corner protectors and strap buckles, narrow gold edging, gold rivets and medical-patch border, gold handle mounts.
prompt_set.anima_medium: Rounded cobalt-blue bottle, luminous blue liquid, cork and blue ribbons. Silver neck band, central filigree, brace and base rim. No gold or brass.
prompt_set.anima_large: Same blue Anima bottle with broad silver filigree shield/braces and conspicuous gold inlay and edges on star motif, neck and base rings.
prompt_set.energy_medium: Tall slender yellow-green vial, cork, leather sling and medicinal leaves. Silver neck, shoulder and base bands, silver buckle/studs, no gold or brass.
prompt_set.energy_large: Same yellow-green energy vial with broad polished silver neck/shoulder/base bands, bright gold borders, gold rivets and silver sling buckle edged in gold.
